one_line: Kushan emperor of the mid-2nd century CE, ruling from Purushapura and Mathura during the flourishing of diverse coinage and early Amitābha devotion.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, tall, broad-shouldered, solid warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, straight nose, deep-set large anime-style eyes, medium wheatish complexion hinting Central Asian and Indian mix, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, calm but commanding default expression with a slight thoughtful frown
appearance.hair: thick dark brown hair, medium length, brushed back from the forehead and tied into a low short knot at the nape; on the head a rounded Kushan-style soft cap of deep red wool with a narrow golden band at its base
appearance.costume: hip-length Kushan royal tunic of rich saffron-yellow wool, long sleeves slightly fitted and ending at the wrist, front crossing slightly to the right and secured with a slim braided crimson sash; over this a knee-length sleeveless coat (coloured deep red) with a subtle vertical woven pattern and a narrow golden trim along the edges; straight cream-colored trousers of sturdy cotton tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitched seams; at the waist a wide leather belt dyed dark brown, supporting a small flat pouch and a pair of understated metal fittings; around his neck a short gold necklace with three small disc pendants, and on his wrists simple gold bangles, conveying royal status without excess; overall silhouette practical yet regal, reflecting Kushan court attire influenced by Central Asian and North Indian styles.
appearance.signature: a single long, slightly curved iron sword in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard, worn at his left hip, with a simple cross-guard and a wooden hilt wrapped in dark red cloth, symbolizing his martial authority and imperial power.

ref_desc: Huvishka is a broad-shouldered Kushan emperor with a short beard, dark brown tied-back hair under a deep red cap, wearing a saffron tunic, red sleeveless coat, cream trousers, brown boots, gold ornaments, and a curved sword in a dark-brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Huvishka: a tall, broad-shouldered Kushan emperor in his early 30s with an oval face, strong jaw, medium wheatish skin, deep-set large eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache. His thick dark brown hair is brushed back and tied in a low short knot at the nape, topped by a rounded deep red wool cap with a narrow golden band. He wears a hip-length saffron-yellow wool tunic with long fitted sleeves and a front that crosses slightly to the right, secured by a slim crimson sash, over which lies a knee-length sleeveless deep red coat with subtle vertical patterning and narrow golden trim along all edges. His straight cream-colored trousers of sturdy cotton are tucked neatly into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple visible stitching. A wide dark-brown leather belt encircles his waist, holding a small flat pouch and understated metal fittings, and he is adorned with a short gold necklace bearing three disc pendants plus simple gold bangles on his wrists. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long, slightly curved iron sword in a plain dark-brown leather scabbard, with a modest cross-guard and a wooden hilt wrapped in dark red cloth. Use a palette dominated by saffron yellow, deep red, cream, brown, and gold, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize the consistent face, tied-back hair with cap, layered Kushan garments, ornaments, and sword placement.
